mapping.draft_py:
# Immortal Phoenix: "When this creature dies, return it to its owner's hand."
# Pitchburn Devils' dies event; the effect is Silversmote Ghoul's self-move from the graveyard
# (CHOOSE over IS_SOURCE, mandatory with count 1), to its owner's hand (Unsummon's destination).
# CR 400.7d: the ability finds the card in the graveyard it went to; the selector zone is every
# graveyard (ANY) because "its owner's" graveyard may not be yours (a stolen Phoenix), and it is
# limited to graveyards so a card that has left the graveyard is not returned.
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
    }),
)
abilities = [dies, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature dies, return it to its owner's hand.
